title: RNA extraction from diatom P. multistriata
author: Francesco Manfellotto
materials: Flash freeze the eppendorf immediately in liquid nitrogen. The eppendorf can be stored at -80 °C for later extraction. Note : Do not wash cells before addition of TRIzol® Reagent. Defrost the samples at room temperature (use thermoshaker for 15 sec at 60 °C if defrosting takes longer). DO NOT PROCESS MORE THAN 6 SAMPLES AT SAME TIME.

steps.title: Harvest Diatom Cells
steps.instruction: Collect 20/40 million P. multistriata cells and harvest them by filtration onto a 1.2 µm pore size filter.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Samples
steps.instruction: Cut the filter into two halves and store each half in a separate 2 mL eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using TRIzol® Reagent and glass beads via thermoshaking.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of TRIzol® Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15596026) to the eppendorf containing half the filter (for 5-10 × 10^6 cells) and vortex briefly.
Add 0.2g acid-washed glass beads, 425-600 μm (30-40 U.S. sieve) (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #G8772-100G).
Place on a thermoshaker at 60 °C for 10 min at maximum rpm (1400).

steps.title: Separate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly for one minute to pellet the beads and filter, then transfer the supernatant into a new 2 mL eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA-containing aqueous phase from proteins and DNA using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl of chloroform per 1 mL of TRIzol used.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 10600 rpm (12,000 g) at 4 °C.
Carefully transfer 500 µl (half the original TRIzol volume) of the uppermost aqueous layer into a new 2 mL eppendorf, ensuring the middle colorless phase and lowermost pink phase are not disturbed.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol (500 µl) and mix by inverting the tube; do not shake.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes (alternatively, store at 4 °C overnight).
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 10600 rpm at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant, leaving the RNA pellet undisturbed.

steps.title: RNA Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol and invert the tube gently to wash the pellet (samples may be stored at -20 °C for long periods).
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 8500 rpm (7500 g) at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant, leaving the RNA pellet undisturbed.

steps.title: Pellet Drying
steps.instruction: Allow the pellet to dry for 20-30 minutes to remove all traces of ethanol, taking care not to over-dry the pellet.

steps.title: RNA Re-suspension
steps.instruction: Re-suspend and dissolve the RNA pellet in RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Re-suspend the pellet in 20-30 µl of RNA-se free water and dissolve by pipetting up and down.
For better re-suspension, incubate samples for 5-10 minutes at 55-60 °C.
Shake the eppendorf vigorously for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
